top_findings.title: No README.md with setup and run instructions
top_findings.evidence: run_dir listing shows only TASK.md, go.mod, go.sum, main.go, main_test.go, scores.json, stack.json (+ logs); no README* file present
top_findings.suggestion: Add a README.md documenting `go mod download`, `go run .`, the endpoints, and `go test ./...`

top_findings.title: Fewer than 3 tests (only 2 present)
top_findings.evidence: main_test.go:33 TestCreateAndGetBook and main_test.go:62 TestListBooksFilter are the only test functions; spec asks for at least 3
top_findings.suggestion: Add a third test (e.g. PUT update, DELETE, validation-rejection, or 404 path)
